pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches on the flank and neck exhibiting moderate edge gradients between dark and light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid of light-colored negative space with clearly defined tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck; mane appears as a dense, dark-brown textural band.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small avian commensals (likely oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal ridge and neck area.
